messages:
alex: heads-up — autoscaler in eu-west went into a scale-down churn around 04:12 and drained 8 GPU nodes in ~6 minutes. A bunch of small training pods were rescheduled and timed out. Logs show aggressive unneeded detection.
mira: ugh. any obvious flag misconfig? what expander are we using there right now? @sam?
sam: that cluster is using a mixed pool (preemptible + reserved) and we switched expander to `least-waste` last week for cost packing tests. pod priorities exist (batch-high) but some evictions ignored them — looks like scale-down kicked before new nodes finished provisioning.
jia: grabbed the autoscaler args from the helm release:
```
--expander=least-waste
--scale-down-unneeded-time=5m
--scale-down-delay-after-add=1m
--max-empty-bulk-delete=2
--max-node-provision-time=12m
```
jia: and the nodepool labels: `node.k8s.io/gpu=true, redwood/price_tier=preemptible` so autoscaler is trying to consolidate and delete empties quickly.
priya: cost perspective: leaving GPUs idle is expensive, but churn and job retries are also costing. We should quantify the tradeoff (idle-hours vs requeue-failures). rough calc: 8 nodes * 4h churn * $3/hr = ~$96 for that incident.
mira: proposal: increase `--scale-down-unneeded-time` to 15m and `--scale-down-delay-after-add` to 10m so we don't kill right after a scale-up. bump `--max-node-provision-time` to 25m for the cloud provider variability. set `--max-empty-bulk-delete=1` so we don't delete multiple gpu groups at once.
sam: agree on safer defaults. also consider `--expander=priority` and add node group priorities so reserved pools are preferred for long-running jobs and preemptible for batch. that should reduce noisy consolidation between pool types.
alex: +1. also let's add a predicate to avoid deleting nodes with recently created pods: `--scale-down-unready-time`/`--ok-total-unready-count` tweaks? not sure exact flags.
jia: exact flags: we can set `--ok-total-unready-count=3` and `--scale-down-unready-time=20m`. also `--unremovable-node-recheck-timeout=5m` helps for transient states.
priya: runbook change: when autoscaler alert fires (rapid-scale-down-eu-west) oncall should check `kubectl get pods --field-selector=status.phase=Pending` and `kubectl describe node` for recent preemptions. add checklist item: check whether reserved pool has capacity set low.
mira: I'll draft a canary change to the helm values and test in staging for 48h. patch will include the flag changes and change to expander=priority with explicit nodeGroup priorities.
sam: sample kustomize patch:
```
- op: replace
  path: /spec/template/spec/containers/0/args/1
  value: "--scale-down-unneeded-time=15m"
```
alex: perfect. can we also add telemetry: add a metric for `autoscaler.node_deletions_per_5m` and alert on >3 deletions in 5m for gpu nodegroups?
priya: yes we can. Grafana panel already has node deletion count, will add an alert rule.
autoscaler-bot: ALERT: rapid-scale-down-eu-west triggered at 1948675320 — 5 node deletions in 4m. Incident channel: #incidents.cc:eng-infra
alex: thanks all — mira please own the staging canary, sam grab the runbook update, jia handle helm patch, priya update alerts. ping here when done :thumbsup:
